actions.reason: Inspect visible workspace and confirm available files before implementing VM setup

args.cmd: set -euo pipefail; pwd; ls -la; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200

success_contract.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU from /app/isos/win311.img, leaving the VM running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop with VNC on :1 (port 5901), nginx on port 80 for web access, snapshot mode enabled, and programmatic keyboard input configured so the VM can receive keystrokes beyond VNC interaction.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process using /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode
VNC listener on port 5901 bound to display :1
nginx listener on port 80 serving a web interface for remote access
A configuration or launch mechanism that enables programmatic keyboard input to QEMU beyond VNC-only interaction
required_behaviors: QEMU remains running in the background after startup
The VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop
The VNC interface is reachable for monitoring
QEMU is configured to accept keyboard input programmatically
known_invalid_patterns: File existence without a running VM
VNC configured on a different display/port
nginx installed but not listening on port 80
Keyboard input only possible through manual VNC interaction
Smoke checks that do not prove the desktop is reached
verification_plan: Inspect workspace and available launch scripts/configuration
Start or repair QEMU with snapshot mode, VNC :1, and keyboard-control-capable interfaces
Start nginx web interface on port 80 if needed
Probe listeners and VM state, then use programmatic input to drive the VM to the Windows 3.11 desktop
Confirm the VM remains running and accessible
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and process state
Receipt-backed evidence that VNC is listening on port 5901
Receipt-backed evidence that nginx is listening on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
Receipt-backed evidence that programmatic keyboard input is configured and usable
